sentences.en: Enough jawboning! Why can't politicians just be honest?
sentences.zh: 别再空谈了！政客们为什么就不能诚实一点呢？

sentences.en: He felt a sharp pain in his jawbone after being hit during the boxing match.
sentences.zh: 他在拳击比赛中被击中后，颚骨感到一阵剧痛。

sentences.en: The archaeologist carefully cleaned the ancient jawbone to study its structure.
sentences.zh: 考古学家仔细清理了这块古颚骨以便研究它的结构。
